title: A Capacity Criterion for Four-State Potts Reconstruction on Trees
summary: For the ferromagnetic four-state broadcast model with $`0\lt \lambda\lt 1`$, we prove that reconstruction on a bounded-degree deterministic rooted tree occurs exactly when its L 3 capacity with edge resistances $`\lambda^{-2|e|}`$ is positive. This gives an exact criterion without regularity or growth-rate assumptions on the tree, including at the exponential critical boundary.
family_title: Exact three- and four-state reconstruction thresholds and four-state tree capacity

review.reason: Proves an exact capacity-based criterion for Potts reconstruction on bounded-degree trees.
